summary: Backend-only verification of the post-reset state and the win path (4/4 pytest cases pass, /app/backend/tests/test_post_reset.py). (1) Clean state BEFORE any test data: GET /api/admin/bank => bank 0.0, liabilities.total 0 (balances/inventory/pending all 0), games {total 0, wins 0, forced_losses 0, forced_by {}}, rtp {wagered 0, paid 0}, ledger []; Mongo: 0 upgrades, 0 luck_cycles, no user with balance>0. (2) Edge (bank=0): player TEST_reset_player_1 with balance 500 betting 50 vs target case-1 (88) lost all 6 rounds with forced_by={'bank': 4} — correct by-design solvency denial, not a bug. (3) Win path with headroom: admin POST /api/admin/bank/adjust +5000 (200, bank 5000) then 40x POST /api/upgrade (bet 50, target 88, ~57% chance) => 23 WINS / 40 games (57.5% win rate). No forced-loss lockout: forced_by={'bank': 4 (from step 2), 'rtp': 3}; final rtp 0.88 <= rtp_target 0.90, bank 5000, liabilities 2024, net +2976. The 'players always lose' bug is confirmed FIXED — wins occur normally once the bank has headroom; only RTP-cap losses are forced. (4) MANDATORY CLEANUP done: reset_all.py re-run (users -1, upgrades -46, drops -23, luck_cycles -1, bank_ledger -1, admin_sessions -2), re-login admin, GET /api/admin/bank again => bank 0, liabilities 0, games 0, ledger []; Mongo verified users 0, upgrades 0, luck_cycles 0, ledger 0, drops 0, bank 0.0, shop_items 8 kept. Admin session/audit rows created by the verification login were also removed — DB is fully clean. No app code modified.
critical_code_review_comments: payout_allowed() uses global liabilities (sum of ALL user balances + inventory + pending withdrawals) vs bank; any single inflated account (as the old 999000 test user) instantly blocks payouts for every player. Consider ignoring non-deposit-backed/admin-seeded balances or tracking liabilities per funded deposits so one bad row can't freeze the whole casino again.

Auto-created guest users (GET /api/user/{session_id}) appear in Mongo with balance 0 from ordinary preview traffic; harmless for liabilities but means 'users collection empty' is not a stable post-reset invariant — reset scripts/tests should assert liabilities==0 instead.
seed_data_creation: Temporary: user TEST_reset_player_1 (balance 500) + bank adjust +5000 + 46 upgrades. ALL removed by reset_all.py at the end; verified clean (bank 0, users 0, upgrades 0, only 8 shop_items remain).
context_for_next_testing_agent: test_post_reset.py must be run serially (`pytest tests/test_post_reset.py -n 0 -s`); tests are order-dependent (01 clean-state -> 02 bank-0 deny -> 03 win path -> 04 reset+verify) and the last test wipes the DB, so run nothing else in parallel. Player JWT is minted with backend JWT_SECRET for session_id TEST_reset_player_1; admin login must be repeated after reset (admin_sessions wiped) and the token is bound to the User-Agent header. DB is currently fully empty (no users, bank 0) — reseed with setup_test_user.py before any UI test.
rca_of_the_issue: Original 'site only drains' RCA confirmed: liabilities() sums every user balance, so the 999000-balance test user made bank + eps < liabilities + target_price permanently true and payout_allowed() returned (False,'bank') for every spin. After the full reset the same code path produces a healthy ~57% win rate at 50/88 stakes, so no code change was needed — only the stale liability row.
